verdict.rationale: YubiKey's core product is a physical hardware authentication device, so self-hosting it is a category error rather than an unmet capability. The evidence shows only hosted adjuncts (the YubiCloud OTP validation API and the YubiEnterprise console) and developer libraries such as java-webauthn-server. None of these documents a self-hostable deployment of the core product, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
